vulnerabilities.description: Reporter Ahmed Albalawi <ahmedalbalawij@gmail.com> Impact moderate Description Several buffer-growth sites in libmime performed size arithmetic in 32-bit types without overflow checks. On a sufficiently large message the growth guard could fail open, or the buffer could be reallocated smaller than required, and a subsequent memcpy would then write attacker-controlled data across adjacent heap allocations. References Bug 2071621
